div.div: فَادِرَةٌ (assumed tropical:) A great, (T, O, K,) hard and solid, (M, K,) mass of rock, (T, M, O, K,) which one sees (T, O) upon the head of a mountain; (T, M, O, K;) likened to the mountain-goat; (M, O;) as also ↓ فِدْرَةٌ . (TA.) [See also what next follows.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
